builds.howItPlays: You hold battlefields with cheap units like Mutated Mouser, a 2-cost unit that gets +2 Might while defending and must take combat damage first, and when you take or hold a battlefield Ivern can turn it into Brush, where your Birds, Cats, Dogs and Poros get +1 Might. You keep cheap spells like Discipline and Defy ready to play on your opponent's turn, winning fights and cancelling their spells, while Kennen, Keeper of Balance can Stun a unit so it deals no combat damage that turn.
builds.whyYou: You like to play defence first: put out a wall of small units, keep a couple of cheap spells in hand, and make your opponent attack into it. You enjoy the decisions on their turn, choosing when to give a unit extra Might or cancel a spell, and deciding each time you take a battlefield whether turning it into Brush is worth using Ivern. You don't mind a game that runs to the middle turns instead of ending fast, because every fight you win keeps your points climbing. If you'd rather hold your ground and punish attacks than race, Ivern suits you.
builds.ratingNotes: Changed 2026-09-25: re-rated from scored deck lists. Pace moved 3 to 5, Stance 5 to 4.5, Variance 5 to 4.5, and deckListUrl changed from the bare /decks page to Bountii's list. The label stays Midrange. The old notes came from guide quotes, not scored decks, and the old guide links (hextechanalytics, c750870f) were dropped because this run did not re-read them. Scored decks (style Kennen Heron Ivern, `tools.ts style` mean Midrange 5/4.5/6.5/4.5, labels Midrange x3): Ivern, Bye Bye Daisy - VEN (Bountii, 11 likes, edited after the ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/6ad473f5-ae83-4a60-8f0c-f406460a7bc8 5/4.5/6.5/4.5; Friend of The Furrest (Best Of Barcelona) (aserty, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/e89f4942-c4bb-4f4d-8897-b709265eacb8 5/4.5/6.5/4.5; Ivern Heron (Raze, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/62523ce5-61ae-45a4-a8cf-444eaeb27f32 5/4.5/6.5/4. Adjustment on every sheet: Complexity +0.5, because the Legend asks on each conquer or hold whether to swap in a Brush battlefield, and the Brush decides where the tribal units should sit. Deciding cards: Pace, 5 cheap units (Mutated Mouser, Stalwart Poro, Trusty Ramhound) set against 5-8 cards costing 5+ (Daisy!, Vilemaw, Astral Heron). Stance, 16-18 answers (Defy, Emperor's Divide, Ki Barrier, Fallen Feline, Back Off, Shield/Tank defenders) against about 9 pressure cards, pulling it below the middle. Complexity, 16-17 reaction-speed cards (Discipline, Friendship, Defy, Hidden Kennen, Call to Glory) plus Friendship's and Daisy!'s tag conditions. Variance, low: no luck or swing cards, steady removal and card draw (Discipline, Ivern, Nurturer), few 3-ofs. The scorer suggested Tempo on all three (Pace 5 with 16-17 reactive cards). Raters kept Midrange because these decks hold battlefields with Shield and Tank units and use their reactions to win fights, not to back cheap attackers. No Axis had a formula-vs-judgment gap of 2 or more. Legend ability: when you conquer or hold, you may exhaust Ivern to replace that battlefield with a Brush token, where Bird, Cat, Dog, Poro and Ivern units have +1 Might. Also played: Hidden Blade Ivern https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/94f53a31-e337-4a14-9879-92076fdbd452 (5.5/5/6/4.5), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/eb8b413d-1c69-4267-9e8a-834b4cddedb7 (5.5/5/6.5/4), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/1162a172-212c-404b-8dbc-65fd81af6a2d (5.5/5.5/6/4.5), the earlier form of the deck, with Hidden Blade, Friendship and Vi in place of Herons and Kennen; Cull the Weak Ivern https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/84819b3e-3849-4b62-81a6-eb3eab04394e (5/4.5/6.5/4.5), Jckcob's 43-like list with Carrion Dredger, Cull the Weak and Zhonya's Hourglass; Vilemaw Nami Ivern https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/9864cfe0-f684-406c-9b02-860c118acb71 (4.5/4.5/6.5/4.5), with Nami stuns and Ambush Vilemaws at the top. Confidence: high. Reviewer check: Bountii's display list runs no Astral Heron (it closes with Daisy!, Vilemaw and Grand Strategem), so the copy names no Heron. aserty's 'Best of Barcelona' claim could not be verified and added no weight. The `tools.ts card` lookup for Astral Heron returned an unrelated card; its text (7 cost, 7 Might) came from the deck sheet.
